title: GENDER BIAS, SOCIAL BIAS AND REPRESENTATION: 70 YEARS OF BHOLLYWOOD

bias_targets.methodology: Calculated Male Pronoun Ratio (MPR), evaluated emotional valence of BERT cloze test completions for men vs. women, analyzed diachronic word embeddings, and quantified bias using Word Embedding Association Tests (WEAT) comparing gender attribute words with occupation sets.
Used BERT cloze tests to predict missing descriptors in phrases like 'A beautiful woman should have [MASK] skin' and analyzed nearest neighbors of the word 'beautiful' in diachronic word embeddings.
Calculated the Male Birth Ratio (MBR) by retrieving dialogues about childbirth to track son preference, and analyzed the evolving nearest neighbors of the word 'dowry' in diachronic word embeddings.
Counted and analyzed the frequency of mentions of different Indian cities and states in movie dialogues to identify regional underrepresentation over time.

Annotated surnames in movie dialogues to calculate religious representation distributions, analyzed nearest neighbors of religious terms like 'Hindu' and 'Muslim' in diachronic embeddings, and ran BERT cloze tests to check for religious polarization.
